integrity: The infinite result is proved symbolically from published exact identities and elementary divisor bounds. The bundled finite verifier is corroborative only and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives exact dyadic lower envelopes and the complete coefficient fibers below 5; it does not classify fibers at 5 or above or give coefficient asymptotics. The published zero fiber is included for completeness and is not claimed as new.
title: Sharp dyadic floors and the complete sub-five spectrum of the two-block odd partition function
